MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 1036 October 4, 1976
PROVIDING FOR THE ACCEPTANCE BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE
PHILIPPINES OF THE SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE ARTICLES OF AGREEMENT OF THE
INTERNATIONAL MONETARY FUND
WHEREAS, the Board of Governors of the International Monetary Fund has approved the proposed Second
Amendment to the Articles of Agreement of the International Monetary Fund which constitutes a major
reforms that will strengthen the international monetary system;
WHEREAS, formal acceptance of the proposed amendment by the member countries including the
Philippines is required to be signified and expressed through an official act of the respective Governments.
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution, do hereby accept, for and in behalf of the Government of the Republic of the
Philippines, the Second Amendment to the Articles of Agreements of the International Monetary Fund
attached to the March, 1976, Report of the Executive Directors to the Board of Governors of the Fund, copy
attached and made an integral part hereof, which will effect significant changes on exchange arrangements,
the reduction of the role of gold in the monetary system, the expansion of the possible uses of special drawing
rights towards making them the principal reserve asset in the monetary system, and the simplification and
expansion of the types of the Fund's financial operations and transactions.
Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of October in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
